messages.author: 8986662aedb94e94
messages.subject: Anonymous login
parts:
Dear all,

The old authentication scheme allowed to create 'anonymous' logins. For instance, we have an app, currently still private, that is linked to a manuscript to be reviewer anonymously. I originally created users reveiwer1, reviewer2, ... and passwords were send out with the manuscript.

Is it possible to implement something similar with the new authentication scheme... as it is not possible to send reviewer an invitation.

Thank you very much in advance.

Best wishes,

Laurent

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Anonymous login
parts:
Hi Laurent,
Unfortunately that is not possible with the new system.  An account of some kind is required.  We have had a couple of requests in the past few weeks for such functionality so we may consider it in the future.   When will your review be complete?

Best,
Tareef
